summary: Uninstall feels laggy because install-state is derived from a disk stat - a Pod wrapper round trip on remote. Fixing it needs an optimistic install-state flip, which relaxes the install-state-IS-files-on-disk invariant. Product decision, parked as an idea.
Widened to both directions - an install's card move lags the same way (toast ~7s, move ~10s). Same disk-stat root.
